listing.name: Better Variants
listing.summary: Adjusts AI fleet composition to make combat more challenging.
listing.aiSummary: Adjusts AI fleet composition to make combat more challenging.

description: Adds new and reworked ship variants for AI fleets, smarter officer assignments, and disables autofit for most vanilla factions. Includes special themed fleets with unique compositions and a bar mission to fight them.
descriptionHtml: Adds new and reworked ship variants for AI fleets, smarter officer assignments, and disables autofit for most vanilla factions. Includes special themed fleets with unique compositions and a bar mission to fight them.
aiDescription: Adds new and reworked ship variants for AI fleets, smarter officer assignments, and disables autofit for most vanilla factions. Includes special themed fleets with unique compositions and a bar mission to fight them.

changelog.1.5.0:
Updated to 0.98
Adjusted some fleets, variants, and officer assignment logic
Requires VariantsLib 0.5.5 or higher to run
changelog.1.4.3:
Added Luna Lib as an optional dependency for LunaSettings. If Luna Lib is not enabled, the values in BetterVariants/data/bettervariants/better_variants_settings.json are used
VariantsLib has also gotten Luna Lib as an optional dependency. If Luna Lib is not enabled, values in VariantsLib/data/variants_lib/variants_lib_settings.json are used
Added the "Harder Remnants" setting, which disables autofit for remnants, gives their officers more relevant skills, and gives them randomly occurring themed fleets
VariantsLib has also gotten a new setting called "Universal No Autofit", which disables autofit for the fleets of all factions
Fixed bugs related to variants not being deep copied before assignment
Requires VariantsLib 0.5.3 or greater to run
changelog.1.4.2: Fixed some hulls in Persean and Luddic Church fleets and markets not showing up as much as they should
